learning_outcomes.text: Know, understand, and apply ecodesign concepts adapted to new situations for professional development.
Acquire environmental ethics concepts that allow for an in-depth analysis of environmental issues that will affect engineers in their professional life.
Develop strategies and procedures for solving environmental problems of products and services.
Work in teams and develop knowledge with critical and responsible technical/cultural exchange.
Plan and manage ecodesign projects according to current legislation.
Critically evaluate product design from an ethical point of view.
Create industrial products and analyze their form and function from biomimetics.
Manage software for designing nature-inspired shapes.
Perform a life cycle assessment on an industrial product.

syllabus_topics: Ethical and bioethical bases of ecological ethics.
Ethical concerns in the ecological field: sustainability and ecological justice. Ethical concerns in the technological field.
Paradigms for addressing ecological ethics problems in engineering: anthropocentrism, biocentrism, and ecofeminism.

assessment_methods.method: Active participation in laboratory and classroom practices

assessment_rules: To be evaluated in ordinary assessment, students must attend at least 80% of practical classes (classroom and laboratory). The final grade is calculated as 0.6 * EV1 + 0.3 * EV2 + 0.1 * EV3. If minimums are not met, the final grade will be the minimum between the calculated score and 4.0. For extraordinary assessment, students must take a written exam and submit an individual work, each contributing 50% to the final grade.
